tasks.label: Auto-Setup Environment with Homebrew and pyenv
tasks.command: if [ ! -d .venv ]; then if [ -f .python-version ]; then pyenv install -s "$(cat .python-version)" || exit 1; fi; python -m venv .venv || exit 1; fi; if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

windows.command: if not exist .venv (if exist .python-version (for /f "delims=" %%i in (.python-version) do pyenv install -s %%i)) && if not exist .venv (python -m venv .venv) && (if exist requirements.txt (.venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt))
